name: Blessing of the Forge
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (two small gold talismans shaped like a hammer and anvil, worth no less than 250 gp)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You can call on your affinity with constructed items to ask them not to harm you. Any forged or crafted items are at –4 on attack rolls to hit you, and deal only half damage to you if they successfully hit. Natural objects, such as a tree branch being used as a club, are not subject to the spell’s effects.
